n: NOAA Monitor National Marine Sanctuary ROV curriculum
t: Free lesson plans where students design, build, and test an underwater ROV.
steps: Find the lesson plans on the NOAA Monitor National Marine Sanctuary page.
Download the Remotely Operated Vehicles curriculum PDF.
Gather the simple materials for the ROV kits.
Ask about borrowing a kit if one is available.
Set up a tub or pool for testing.
Divide the class into teams of 2 to 4.
